Foxglove | Multiple eng + GTM roles | Onsite (San Francisco) + Remote (Europe)| Full Time | https://www.foxglove.dev/careers

We build developer infrastructure for Physical AI. Robotics and embodied-AI teams run their data flywheel on us: visualization, multimodal logging (MCAP), search and curation, observability, eval, and fleet management. Stack is Rust on the backend and data side, TypeScript with WebGL and WASM for visualization, Python for ML and eval.

Series B, ~80 people, backed by Bessemer, founded by Cruise and Coinbase alumni. AV or robotics experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Open roles (Senior/Staff):

- ML Engineer

- Product Manager, Data + ML

- FDE, Europe

- Design Engineer

- Account Executive (Defense and Aerospace)

All roles and apply: https://www.foxglove.dev/careers

Questions: email in profile (mention HN)
